description:
Yu Yu was bullied during his school days for his obesity, but after years of hard work and exercise, he has become a famous beauty director sought by everyone. However, his issues with talking to women pose a problem when dealing with customers. Thus his boss assigns him and several other troublemakers a project in order to fix their problems. During this event, his old crush, Ain Joo, appears in front of him.

[Original Webtoon](https://page.kakao.com/content/54310637)
